title: How to score free Target gift cards
description: There are several ways to score free gift cards for Target, thanks in part to gift card promotions and trade-in programs.

asr.full_text: Target is one of America's favorite retailers and likely where you'll be doing some holiday shopping. Or shopping all the time. There are several ways to score free gift cards for Target,. Thanks in part to its gift card promotions and trade-in programs. Nikki Kimmelton explains how you can get your hands on these gift cards for free. So there are several ways to do this. The first of which is just to simply shop at Target. You can rack up free Target gift cards just for shopping at the retailer, including online. Look for promotions for free Target gift cards with certain purchases. You'll find these in the weekly ads or on the promotions page. Next, did you know that you can sell your clutter to Target's trade-in program? If you have electronics sitting around unused, sell them to Target. To get started, look up an item on the trade-in program's website. It'll tell you the amount of the Target gift card that you can score. If you decide to proceed with the trade. And finally, if you have any unwanted gift cards lying around,. You can exchange them at Target. You'll get a Target gift card instead. To find out if Target accepts the brand of gift card you want to exchange or to find a store where you can exchange it, not all stores do it, check the gift card trade-in program website. I've actually put links to that page and the others I mentioned inside this story on the consumer section of news4jax.com. Nikki Kimballton, Channel 4, the local station.
